import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive insights
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# 1. Sales by Product (Top left - large)
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
bars1 = ax1.bar(range(len(product_sales)), product_sales.values, color=colors[:len(product_sales)])
ax1.set_xticks(range(len(product_sales)))
ax1.set_xticklabels(product_sales.index, rotation=45, ha='right')
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Total Sales by Product', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
for i, bar in enumerate(bars1):
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax1.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height,
             f'${height:.0f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 2. Sales by Customer Age Group (Top right)
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
age_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_sales_ordered = age_sales.reindex([x for x in age_order if x in age_sales.index])
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax2.pie(age_sales_ordered.values, labels=age_sales_ordered.index,
                                     autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors, startangle=90)
ax2.set_title('Sales Distribution by Age Group', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')
    autotext.set_fontsize(9)

# 3. Payment Method Distribution (Middle left)
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
payment_counts = df['payment_method'].value_counts()
bars3 = ax3.barh(range(len(payment_counts)), payment_counts.values, color=colors[:len(payment_counts)])
ax3.set_yticks(range(len(payment_counts)))
ax3.set_yticklabels(payment_counts.index)
ax3.set_xlabel('Number of Transactions', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Payment Methods Used', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
for i, bar in enumerate(bars3):
    width = bar.get_width()
    ax3.text(width, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2.,
             f'{int(width)}', ha='left', va='center', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Takeaway vs Dine-in (Middle center)
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
takeaway_data = df.groupby('is_takeaway')['total'].agg(['sum', 'count'])
labels = ['Dine-in', 'Takeaway']
colors_takeaway = ['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4']
x = np.arange(len(labels))
width = 0.35
bars4a = ax4.bar(x - width/2, takeaway_data['sum'].values, width, label='Total Sales ($)', color=colors_takeaway[0], alpha=0.8)
ax4_twin = ax4.twinx()
bars4b = ax4_twin.bar(x + width/2, takeaway_data['count'].values, width, label='Transactions', color=colors_takeaway[1], alpha=0.8)
ax4.set_xlabel('Service Type', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold', color=colors_takeaway[0])
ax4_twin.set_ylabel('Number of Transactions', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold', color=colors_takeaway[1])
ax4.set_title('Takeaway vs Dine-in Comparison', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xticks(x)
ax4.set_xticklabels(labels)
ax4.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor=colors_takeaway[0])
ax4_twin.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor=colors_takeaway[1])
ax4.legend(loc='upper left', fontsize=9)
ax4_twin.legend(loc='upper right', fontsize=9)

# 5. Average Price by Size (Middle right)
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
size_avg_price = df.groupby('size')['price'].mean().reindex([x for x in size_order if x in df['size'].unique()])
bars5 = ax5.bar(range(len(size_avg_price)), size_avg_price.values, color=['#95E1D3', '#F38181', '#AA96DA'])
ax5.set_xticks(range(len(size_avg_price)))
ax5.set_xticklabels(size_avg_price.index)
ax5.set_ylabel('Average Price ($)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Average Price by Size', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
for i, bar in enumerate(bars5):
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax5.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height,
             f'${height:.2f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold')

# 6. Sales Trend by Hour (Bottom - spanning all columns)
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, :])
df['hour'] = pd.to_datetime(df['time'], format='%H:%M').dt.hour
hourly_sales = df.groupby('hour')['total'].sum()
ax6.plot(hourly_sales.index, hourly_sales.values, marker='o', linewidth=2.5, 
         markersize=6, color='#E74C3C', alpha=0.8)
ax6.fill_between(hourly_sales.index, hourly_sales.values, alpha=0.3, color='#E74C3C')
ax6.set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_title('Sales Trend Throughout the Day', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax6.grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
ax6.set_xticks(range(0, 24, 2))
ax6.set_xlim(-0.5, 23.5)

# Add overall title
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analytics Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
